name: Choose a minimal effective correction
when: A spatial violation has been diagnosed and a legal correction must be chosen.
procedure: Determine which permitted pose component addresses the diagnosed problem.
Inspect clearance in the proposed direction using available evidence.
Change a limited number of pose parameters and inspect the outcome before escalating the correction.
verification: The diagnosed violation decreases or disappears without an evident new violation.
failure_lessons: Do not shrink or delete an object unless the task explicitly permits that operation.
adaptation_notes: Original bounded-edit procedure; legality is always controlled by the task action profile.
